title: Reinforcement learning agents in CARLA
summary: Autonomous driving agents using DQN and A2C in the CARLA simulator, with synchronous and asynchronous simulation environments.

title: Rumour detection with BERT and GCN
summary: A model for classifying discussion stances and detecting rumours in Twitter and Reddit data from RumourEval 2019. The project combines BERT with a three-layer graph convolutional network.
details: Reported results: 67% accuracy for stance classification and 70% for rumour detection. Selected as the best study in the Advanced Natural Language Processing class.

title: Music NFTs and audience engagement
summary: A Measure of Music conference project examining music NFT releases using Chartmetric data. The analysis considered Shawn Mendes and Tory Lanez releases alongside follower and streaming trends.
tools: Chartmetric · Music analytics · Measure of Music 2022
details: The analysis did not establish a direct relationship between the selected NFT releases and follower or streaming changes. Available metrics limited the conclusions that could be drawn about their impact.
